sentences: Overall 3.98x on day 2 so far; QIB 6.89x, NII 1.9x, retail 3.17x.
From listing day 2.23 crore shares can trade (the free float): the IPO's shares. Everything else is locked in for a while.
03 May 2027: shares of other investors from before the ipo (8.9 lakh shares) can be sold, 4% of the free float (assumed: SEBI's usual period, not found in the RHP's capital structure).
03 May 2027: promoters' shares above their minimum stake (2.67 crore shares) can be sold, 119.6% of the free float (the RHP (page 113)). A big unlock: watch the price around this date.
03 May 2028: promoters' minimum stake (1.25 crore shares) can be sold, 55.9% of the free float (the RHP (page 113)). A big unlock: watch the price around this date.
The anchor book isn't known yet: upload the anchor allocation to add the 30- and 90-day anchor unlocks.
Periods marked assumed weren't found in the RHP's capital structure; check its lock-in table and type them in on the facts screen if they differ.
